# Noxtua and GrowthBook
Date: 2026-08-27 | Duration: 20.389999389648438m

## Summary
The meeting centered around improving customer engagement and sales strategies for enterprise prospects. The team discussed tailoring demos and pricing, particularly emphasizing a self-hosted solution to meet client needs. Notable contributions included identifying Helena as an internal champion for adoption and addressing pricing concerns for a prospect with approximately $600 million in revenue. James Shannon clarified product tier features, ensuring the prospect understands differences, while Marcel and Remy developed pricing strategies starting at higher initial points to facilitate negotiation. Strong interest was noted in product usability, particularly the visual editor, but gaps in data integration and the involvement of multiple teams were highlighted as critical points for advancing discussions. Discussions on competitive positioning and the prospect's motivations also shaped the strategy.

## Keywords
self-hosted, event-based pricing, Pro tier, dashboard features, customer engagement, enterprise negotiation
